verse.verse_2: And by oath of ten nights.
verse.verse_3: And by oath of the even and the odd.
verse.verse_4: And by oath of the night when it recedes
verse.verse_5: Why is there an oath in this, for the intelligent?
verse.verse_6: Did you not see how did your Lord deal with (the tribe of) Aad?
verse.verse_8: Like whom no one else was born in the cities.
verse.verse_9: And the tribe of Thamud, who hewed rocks in the valley.
verse.verse_10: And with Firaun, who used to crucify.
verse.verse_11: Those who rebelled in the cities,
verse.verse_12: And who then spread a lot of turmoil in them.
verse.verse_13: Therefore your Lord struck them hard with the means of punishment.
verse.verse_14: Indeed nothing is hidden from the sight of your Lord.
verse.verse_15: So man, whenever his Lord tests him by giving him honour and favours – thereupon he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”
verse.verse_16: And if He tests him and restricts his livelihood – thereupon he says, “My Lord has degraded me!”
verse.verse_17: Not at all – but rather you do not honour the orphan.
verse.verse_18: And do not urge one another to feed the needy.
verse.verse_19: And you readily devour the inheritance with greed.
verse.verse_20: And you harbour intense love for wealth.
verse.verse_21: Most certainly – when the earth is smashed and blown to bits.
verse.verse_22: And when the command of your Lord comes – and the angels row by row,
verse.verse_23: And when hell is brought that day – on that day will man reflect, but where is the time now to think?
verse.verse_24: He will say, “Alas – if only I had sent some good deeds ahead, during my lifetime!”
verse.verse_25: So on that day, no one punishes like He does!
verse.verse_26: And no one binds like He does!
verse.verse_28: Return towards your Lord – you being pleased with Him, and He pleased with you!
verse.verse_29: Then enter the ranks of My chosen bondmen!
